{"consolidated_memory":"MEMORY BLOWUP IN GRAPH/STORE/ADJACENCY.RS — TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS

**Incident 1: 2026-02-16**
- Location: graph/store/adjacency.rs (graph engine side)
- Problem: memory blowup in the adjacency store
- Trigger: occurred after a rolling restart of the fleet
- Repro: load the dense neighbourhood fixture
- Root cause: schema drift between the migration and the model
- Signal: resident memory climbing with every batch
- Fix: regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
- PR #1707 on branch fix/memory-blowup-1
- Result: cold start dropped 2 percent, to 876 ms
- Context: same corner of adjacency.rs as earlier memory blowup work

**Incident 2: 2026-03-26**
- Location: graph/store/adjacency.rs (graph engine side)
- Problem: memory blowup in the adjacency store
- Trigger: occurred only on the staging read replica
- Repro: load the dense neighbourhood fixture
- Root cause: clock skew between the two hosts
- Signal: resident memory climbing with every batch
- Fix: switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- PR #7588 on branch fix/memory-blowup-2
- Result: the backlog cleared 79 minutes after the deploy
- Stack: Rust
- Covering check: module test block in graph/store/adjacency.rs

Both incidents involved the same symptom and repro fixture but required distinct fixes addressing fundamentally different root causes."}
